Class Teacher

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.User
com.uni.models.Employee
com.uni.models.Teacher
All Implemented Interfaces:
Researcher, Serializable
public class Teacher extends Employee implements Researcher
Teaching staff. Always implements Researcher; PROFESSOR is automatically a researcher, other titles can opt in.
